Location sharing with family is on
This phone sends its location and battery level to your family\'s guardians when it moves, at most once every 5 minutes. Open Family OS to see what is shared.
This phone was disconnected from the family, so it no longer sends its location. Sharing again needs a new pairing from a guardian\'s phone.
